summary: CEMEX filed a 6-K announcing the second installment of its previously declared USD $180 million cash dividend. This installment is USD $45 million, payable September 17, 2026, to holders of Series A/B, CPOs, and ADSs as of September 15, 2026 record date. Amounts are approximately USD $0.001039 per share, USD $0.003117 per CPO, and USD $0.031170 per ADS. The dividend draws from CUFIN, resulting in no withholding. Future installments expected December 16, 2026, and March 3, 2027. This is a routine dividend event; no special-situation implications beyond capital returns.
